versions.changelog:
Mobula Wallet skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Track wallet portfolios and transaction history across 88+ blockchains.
- Monitor holdings, analyze trades, and follow whale wallet activity in real time.
- Supports cross-chain portfolio overviews and detailed transaction queries.
- Offers read-only access with no private key requirement—secure and privacy-conscious.
- Requires a Mobula API key for authentication (free tier available).
